rows.grounds: compound of face-counts modifying beads; accusative plural masculine
locative dual neuter phrase for both ears

items.question: Which faced rudraksha beads and how many are prescribed for wearing on both ears?
premises: The verse continues a rudraksha wearing prescription.
It names face-counts for beads worn on ears.
It specifies two ears as the wearing location.
items.inference: Six and six beads with ten, seven, and five faces are to be worn on both ears.
uncertainties: The exact distribution of face-counts between the two ears is not explicit.
The token ṣaṭṣaṭ may indicate count rather than separate bead groups.
items.plain_english: Thus wear beads with ten, seven, and five faces, six and six, on both ears.
